verdict.rationale: Amazon Bedrock is AWS's own managed service giving access to "hundreds of FMs from leading AI companies," including a frontier model (Claude 3 Sonnet), so first-party managed inference over third-party models is evidenced. The pack does not cover the full story: no documented Bedrock inference API reference is cited, and open-weight models are not explicitly named. missing for 10: evidence of a documented Bedrock inference API (endpoints/SDK reference), explicit coverage of open-weight models, independent or hands-on corroboration of inference use.

support.subject: As an AI-native team, models are a platform service — first-party managed inference over frontier and open models with a documented API

citations.quote: Amazon Bedrock gives you access to hundreds of FMs from leading AI companies along with evaluation tools to pick the best model based on your unique performance and cost needs.
